tables.name: Goings On
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Interesting occurrences happening at the moment.

results.name: Worker’s Compensation
results.description: A worker has been injured on the job, and folks are rushing to help them.

results.name: Road Merchant
results.description: A travelling merchant just arrived in town, and has all kinds of unique things to show and sell.

results.name: Children Missing
results.description: Some of the younger villagers have gone missing. How long have they been gone? What were they last seen doing?

results.name: Fallen Rider
results.description: A severely injured man in armor has ridden into the village, late at night, and fallen, unconscious, from his horse. He is wearing a tabard displaying an unfamiliar coat of arms.

results.name: They’re Mine
results.description: Two villagers are competing for the hand of a local heartthrob.

results.name: Echoes in the Deep
results.description: A villager swears they can hear sounds like voices coming from underground.
